Name: Seven Samurai
Review:
Call me tiktok brained or whatever, but I genuinely don’t understand how this is appealing to the modern viewer.

Sure it’s influential but in the over half a century this movie’s been out, creators in all mediums of fiction have iterated and improved on the ideas presented in this film.

Nothing in this movie was new to me and the good moments are just overshadowed by other works I’ve already seen.

It’s also long as hell and boring for the most part. Not to mention that what should be the best part (“This baby is me!”) is ruined by ham-fisted acting and cutting away too quickly.
